[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Why Agent Web Search"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Traditional search aggregation (Google/Bing/Baidu wrappers, scraped SERPs)
sends a keyword query to "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"conventional engines and merges result pages. Agent
Web Search instead aggregates **search capabilit"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ies built for agents**: one
tool call returns structured, citation-ready evidence — or, through
mode"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"l-native grounding providers, a synthesized answer with explicit
citations. A measured benchmark sho"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"ws the
practical difference: on a natural-language Chinese query asking for official
sources, conven"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"tional SERP backends returned no government-domain results in
the top 5, while the grounding provide"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"r returned official figures from
China's General Administration of Customs with a working citation."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **Agent-native by design.** The primary interface is a complete natural-language
question, not a t"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"hin keyword fan-out to Google, Bing, or Baidu.
- **Model-native search backends.** ARK, Gemini, Grok"},{"id":"p28s3","text":", DeepSeek, Responses,
Messages, Zhipu Chat Search, and Codex Alpha can combine web retrieval with
m"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"odel-generated synthesis and explicit citations.
- **Agent search providers.** Exa, Parallel, Brave,"},{"id":"p28s5","text":" Perplexity, Tavily, You.com,
and Zhipu Web Search expose search APIs intended to provide structured"},{"id":"p28s6","text":",
citation-friendly, or context-ready evidence to downstream agents.
- **One provider-neutral contra"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"ct.** Every backend is available through the same
MCP tool, CLI, Python API, and normalized `results"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"`; model-backed providers may
also return an `answer`.
- **Independent providers.** Selected provide"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"rs run concurrently, and one
provider's failure never discards another provider's successful result."},{"id":"p28s10","text":"
- **DDGS remains a simple fallback.** DDGS is the only conventional search
backend; it requires no "},{"id":"p28s11","text":"API key and keeps the project usable without paid
provider credentials. Exa and Parallel are also ke"},{"id":"p28s12","text":"yless by default.
- **No telemetry, no shared secrets.** Provider keys stay in runtime
environment v"},{"id":"p28s13","text":"ariables; there is no shared API-key service."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### What is Agent Web Search?"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Agent Web Search is an open-source web search layer for AI agents. It exposes
one `web_search` tool "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"through an MCP server (stdio or Streamable HTTP), a CLI,
and a Python API. Behind that tool it runs "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"model-native search grounding
providers (ARK, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Zhipu Chat Search, Codex Alpha"},{"id":"p30s4","text":", and
generic Responses/Messages gateways), agent search APIs (Exa, Parallel, Brave,
Perplexity, Tav"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"ily, You.com, Zhipu Web Search), and DuckDuckGo as a
conventional fallback, then returns one normali"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"u Web Search), and DuckDuckGo as a
conventional fallback, then returns one normalized JSON response."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### Can I use my own OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible gateway for search grounding?"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Yes. The `responses` provider calls any OpenAI Responses API gateway with a
server-side web search t"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ool, and the `messages` provider does the same for
Anthropic Messages API gateways. Set the base URL"},{"id":"p32s3","text":", key, and models through the
variables in Provider settings."}],"truncated":true}
